description: SCUM dedicated server (Steam app 3792580). Runs as a background process; restart warnings go through SCUM's own Notifications.json. Who is on, first seen and time played come from its login log and database (the player graph starts with the past week); bans and admin / moderator rights go into BannedUsers.ini and AdminUsers.ini, which SCUM reads when it starts. Uses SCUM's default ports (7777 UDP, 7779 TCP, 27015 UDP) - change them in config.json if you need others.

messages: Puppets hunt by sound. A gunshot carries for a kilometer - a knife doesn't.
Every trader has quests. Finish enough in one tier and better-paying work unlocks.
Medicine is worth more than money. Carry bandages.
Crows and seagulls are back. A flock taking off gives away your position - and a bird is meat and feathers.
Fishing quests come in three tiers, and a leaderboard tracks the biggest catches.
Restarts always come with a warning. Find a safe spot when it comes.
